sql: select market_ticker, side, action, limit_price, quantity, status, cancel_reason, created_at::text, (select max(started_at)::text from incentive_discovery_cycles) disc, (select string_agg(at::text || chr(32) || residual_cents, chr(124)) from incentive_balance_observations where at > timestamp '2026-10-11 11:00' and residual_cents > 99) credits from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-13 04:20' or status in ('resting','partial','pending','submitted','unknown') or (market_ticker = 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT13-FENT' and created_at > '2026-10-13 04:00')) order by created_at desc limit 20
